id-20260902-news-1.title: Non-Subsidized Fuel Prices Rise as of September 1, 2026, Dexlite and Pertamina Dex Surge by Up to 20 Percent

segments.src: PT Pertamina Patra Niaga resmi menyesuaikan harga sejumlah produk bahan bakar minyak (BBM) non-subsidi mulai 1 September 2026.
segments.tr: PT Pertamina Patra Niaga officially adjusted the prices of several non-subsidized fuel oil (BBM) products starting September 1, 2026.

segments.src: Penyesuaian ini merupakan bagian dari mekanisme rutin bulanan yang mengacu pada formula harga dasar, yaitu rata-rata harga acuan minyak dunia (Mean of Platts Singapore/MOPS) serta pergerakan nilai tukar rupiah terhadap dolar Amerika Serikat pada periode sebelumnya.
segments.tr: This adjustment is part of a routine monthly mechanism referring to the base price formula, which is the average world oil benchmark price (Mean of Platts Singapore/MOPS) and the movement of the rupiah exchange rate against the US dollar in the previous period.

segments.src: Manajemen Pertamina Patra Niaga menyatakan bahwa penyesuaian harga BBM non-subsidi dilakukan secara berkala setiap bulan agar tetap kompetitif dan mengikuti perkembangan harga minyak dunia, sejalan dengan praktik yang juga diterapkan oleh badan usaha penyalur BBM lain di Indonesia seperti Shell, BP-AKR, dan Vivo.
segments.tr: Pertamina Patra Niaga management stated that the adjustment of non-subsidized fuel prices is carried out periodically every month to remain competitive and follow world oil price developments, in line with practices also applied by other fuel distributor business entities in Indonesia such as Shell, BP-AKR, and Vivo.

segments.src: ## Rincian Kenaikan Harga per Jenis BBM
segments.tr: ## Details of Price Increases per Fuel Type

segments.src: Berdasarkan pengumuman resmi yang berlaku untuk wilayah Jakarta dan sekitarnya (Zona 1), berikut gambaran perubahan harga per 1 September 2026:
segments.tr: Based on the official announcement applicable to the Jakarta area and its surroundings (Zone 1), here is an overview of price changes as of September 1, 2026:

segments.src: - **Pertamax Turbo (RON 98)**: naik dari sekitar Rp13.700 menjadi sekitar Rp14.800 per liter.
segments.tr: - **Pertamax Turbo (RON 98)**: rose from around Rp13.700 to around Rp14.800 per liter.

segments.src: - **Dexlite (CN 51)**: naik tajam dari sekitar Rp13.400 menjadi sekitar Rp16.100 per liter, atau naik sekitar 20 persen.
segments.tr: - **Dexlite (CN 51)**: rose sharply from around Rp13.400 to around Rp16.100 per liter, or an increase of about 20 percent.

segments.src: - **Pertamina Dex (CN 53)**: naik dari sekitar Rp13.900 menjadi sekitar Rp16.400 per liter.
segments.tr: - **Pertamina Dex (CN 53)**: rose from around Rp13.900 to around Rp16.400 per liter.

segments.src: - **Pertamax 92 (RON 92)**: tetap di kisaran Rp12.100 per liter.
- **Pertamax Green 95**: tetap di kisaran Rp13.000 per liter.
segments.tr: - **Pertamax Green 95**: remained around Rp13.000 per liter.

segments.src: Perlu dicatat, harga aktual di lapangan dapat berbeda antar provinsi karena adanya komponen Pajak Bahan Bakar Kendaraan Bermotor (PBBKB) yang besarannya ditetapkan masing-masing pemerintah daerah.
segments.tr: Please note, actual prices in the field may differ between provinces due to the Motor Vehicle Fuel Tax (PBBKB) component whose amount is determined by each local government.

segments.src: Masyarakat disarankan mengecek harga terbaru melalui aplikasi resmi MyPertamina atau papan informasi harga di stasiun pengisian bahan bakar umum (SPBU) terdekat.
segments.tr: The public is advised to check the latest prices through the official MyPertamina application or price information boards at the nearest public gas stations (SPBU).

segments.src: Penting untuk digarisbawahi bahwa kenaikan ini hanya berlaku untuk produk BBM non-subsidi.
segments.tr: It is important to underline that this increase only applies to non-subsidized fuel products.

segments.src: Harga Pertalite dan Biosolar bersubsidi, yang penyalurannya diatur dan disubsidi oleh pemerintah, tidak mengalami perubahan dan tetap mengikuti ketentuan harga yang telah ditetapkan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: The prices of subsidized Pertalite and Biosolar, whose distribution is regulated and subsidized by the government, do not experience changes and continue to follow the previously established price provisions.
## Potential Impact on the Logistics Sector

segments.src: Dexlite dan Pertamina Dex selama ini menjadi pilihan utama bagi kendaraan niaga bermesin diesel, termasuk truk logistik, bus antarkota, dan alat berat, karena kualitas bahan bakarnya yang lebih tinggi dibandingkan solar subsidi.
segments.tr: Dexlite and Pertamina Dex have long been the main choice for diesel-powered commercial vehicles, including logistics trucks, intercity buses, and heavy equipment, due to their higher fuel quality compared to subsidized diesel.

segments.src: Kenaikan harga kedua produk tersebut yang mencapai sekitar 20 persen berpotensi menambah beban biaya operasional pelaku usaha angkutan barang dan logistik.
segments.tr: The price increase of both products reaching about 20 percent has the potential to add to the operational cost burden of freight transport and logistics business actors.

segments.src: Sejumlah pelaku usaha di sektor transportasi barang mengingatkan bahwa momentum kenaikan ini terjadi menjelang periode akhir tahun, saat permintaan jasa pengiriman biasanya meningkat seiring musim belanja dan persiapan liburan.
segments.tr: Several business actors in the goods transportation sector reminded that this price increase momentum occurs ahead of the year-end period, when shipping service demand usually increases along with the shopping season and holiday preparations.

segments.src: Kenaikan biaya bahan bakar berpotensi turut memengaruhi struktur tarif jasa angkutan dan pada akhirnya biaya distribusi barang, meski besarannya akan sangat bergantung pada efisiensi operasional masing-masing perusahaan serta dinamika pasar.
segments.tr: The increase in fuel costs has the potential to also affect the structure of transportation service rates and ultimately the cost of goods distribution, although the amount will depend heavily on the operational efficiency of each company and market dynamics.

segments.src: Beberapa asosiasi pengusaha angkutan disebut tengah mengevaluasi dampak kenaikan ini terhadap struktur biaya operasional armada, termasuk mempertimbangkan opsi efisiensi rute dan konsumsi bahan bakar.
segments.tr: Several transportation business associations are reportedly evaluating the impact of this increase on fleet operational cost structures, including considering options for route efficiency and fuel consumption.

segments.src: Sementara itu, konsumen kendaraan pribadi berbahan bakar Pertamax Turbo maupun Pertamina Dex disarankan untuk memantau perkembangan harga secara berkala mengingat sifat penyesuaian ini yang dapat berubah setiap bulan mengikuti kondisi pasar minyak global.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, consumers of private vehicles fueled by Pertamax Turbo or Pertamina Dex are advised to monitor price developments periodically considering the nature of this adjustment which can change every month following global oil market conditions.

segments.src: Masyarakat dan pelaku usaha diimbau untuk terus memantau pengumuman resmi dari Pertamina Patra Niaga melalui kanal informasi resmi perusahaan guna mendapatkan data harga yang akurat dan terkini.
segments.tr: The public and business actors are urged to continue monitoring official announcements from Pertamina Patra Niaga through the company's official information channels to obtain accurate and up-to-date price data.

id-20260902-news-3.title: Pertalite QR Restriction Trial Held in 42 Cities, Purbaya Claims It Can Save 10 Percent of Energy Budget

segments.src: Pemerintah mulai menjajal skema baru untuk menata penyaluran bahan bakar minyak (BBM) bersubsidi jenis Pertalite.
segments.tr: The government has started testing a new scheme to organize the distribution of subsidized fuel oil of the Pertalite type.

segments.src: Kementerian Keuangan bersama PT Pertamina (Persero) dilaporkan menjalankan uji coba sistem *quick response* atau kode QR untuk membatasi pembelian Pertalite di 42 kota dan kabupaten yang tersebar di empat provinsi.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Finance together with PT Pertamina (Persero) is reported to be running a trial of the *quick response* system or QR code to restrict Pertalite purchases in 42 cities and regencies spread across four provinces.

segments.src: Berdasarkan keterangan yang beredar, tahap awal uji coba ini menyasar konsumen yang masuk kategori desil 10, yakni kelompok masyarakat dengan tingkat kesejahteraan tertinggi dalam data pemeringkatan sosial ekonomi nasional.
segments.tr: Based on circulating information, the initial stage of this trial targets consumers who fall into the decile 10 category, namely the group of people with the highest welfare level in the national socio-economic ranking data.

segments.src: Dengan kata lain, kelompok yang selama ini dianggap paling mampu secara ekonomi akan lebih dulu diatur akses pembeliannya terhadap Pertalite melalui verifikasi kode QR di titik pengisian bahan bakar.
segments.tr: In other words, the group that has been considered the most economically capable will have their purchase access to Pertalite regulated first through QR code verification at refueling points.

segments.src: Mekanisme berbasis QR ini pada dasarnya berfungsi sebagai alat verifikasi identitas dan kelayakan pembeli sebelum transaksi pengisian BBM subsidi dilakukan.
segments.tr: This QR-based mechanism basically functions as an identity and buyer eligibility verification tool before subsidized fuel filling transactions are carried out.

segments.src: Dengan sistem ini, petugas maupun operator SPBU diharapkan dapat memastikan bahwa Pertalite bersubsidi benar-benar terserap oleh kelompok yang menjadi sasaran kebijakan, bukan oleh kalangan yang sebenarnya tidak masuk kategori penerima manfaat.
segments.tr: With this system, officers and gas station operators are expected to ensure that subsidized Pertalite is truly absorbed by the group targeted by the policy, not by circles that actually do not fall into the beneficiary category.
## Potential Savings Claim of Up to 10 Percent

segments.src: Menteri Keuangan Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa menyampaikan bahwa skema pembatasan bertahap ini berpotensi menekan belanja subsidi energi secara signifikan.
segments.tr: Minister of Finance Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa stated that this phased restriction scheme has the potential to significantly suppress energy subsidy spending.

segments.src: Ia menyebut penataan distribusi Pertalite melalui pendekatan berbasis data dan verifikasi digital semacam ini berpotensi menghemat anggaran subsidi energi hingga sekitar 10 persen.
segments.tr: He mentioned that the arrangement of Pertalite distribution through a data-based approach and digital verification like this has the potential to save the energy subsidy budget by up to around 10 percent.

segments.src: Menurut Purbaya, efisiensi tersebut dimungkinkan karena selama ini sebagian volume Pertalite bersubsidi diduga masih terserap oleh kelompok yang secara ekonomi sebenarnya tidak termasuk sasaran utama subsidi.
segments.tr: According to Purbaya, this efficiency is made possible because so far a portion of the subsidized Pertalite volume is suspected to still be absorbed by groups that economically are actually not included in the main target of the subsidy.

segments.src: Dengan memperbaiki ketepatan sasaran, pemerintah meyakini anggaran subsidi energi bisa dialokasikan secara lebih optimal tanpa perlu memangkas kuota atau mempersulit akses bagi masyarakat yang benar-benar membutuhkan.
segments.tr: By improving targeting accuracy, the government believes the energy subsidy budget can be allocated more optimally without needing to cut quotas or make access difficult for people who truly need it.

segments.src: Purbaya juga menyampaikan bahwa uji coba yang saat ini masih berjalan di skala terbatas ini direncanakan untuk diperluas cakupannya, salah satunya menyasar kelompok desil 9 pada tahap berikutnya.
segments.tr: Purbaya also stated that the trial which is currently still running on a limited scale is planned to have its coverage expanded, one of which targets the decile 9 group in the next stage.

segments.src: Pendekatan bertahap ini disebut sengaja dirancang agar penyesuaian kebijakan dapat dievaluasi terlebih dahulu di lapangan sebelum diterapkan pada cakupan wilayah dan kelompok masyarakat yang lebih luas.
segments.tr: This gradual approach is said to be intentionally designed so that policy adjustments can be evaluated first in the field before being applied to a wider scope of regions and community groups.

segments.src: Pemerintah menegaskan bahwa arah kebijakan ini bukan ditujukan untuk mengetatkan alokasi Pertalite bagi masyarakat kurang mampu maupun kelompok menengah yang selama ini memang menjadi sasaran subsidi.
segments.tr: The government emphasized that the direction of this policy is not intended to tighten the allocation of Pertalite for underprivileged people or the middle class who have so far been the targets of the subsidy.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, penataan ini diklaim justru bertujuan menjaga agar subsidi tetap tersedia secara memadai bagi kelompok yang berhak, dengan cara mengurangi kebocoran alokasi ke segmen yang dinilai sudah mampu membeli BBM nonsubsidi.
segments.tr: Conversely, this arrangement is claimed to actually aim at keeping the subsidy adequately available for groups that are entitled, by reducing allocation leakage to segments considered already capable of buying non-subsidized fuel.

segments.src: Uji coba berbasis QR di 42 kota dan kabupaten ini masih akan melalui proses evaluasi sebelum diputuskan untuk diperluas secara nasional.
segments.tr: This QR-based trial in 42 cities and regencies will still go through an evaluation process before it is decided to be expanded nationally.

segments.src: Sejumlah aspek seperti kesiapan infrastruktur digital di SPBU, akurasi data kependudukan dan sosial ekonomi yang menjadi rujukan, hingga sosialisasi kepada masyarakat menjadi faktor yang disebut turut menentukan keberhasilan program ini.
segments.tr: A number of aspects such as digital infrastructure readiness at gas stations, the accuracy of population and socio-economic data used as reference, up to socialization to the community are factors mentioned to also determine the success of this program.

segments.src: Kalangan pengamat energi sebelumnya kerap menyoroti perlunya perbaikan tata kelola distribusi BBM bersubsidi agar lebih tepat sasaran, mengingat besarnya beban anggaran subsidi energi dalam struktur belanja negara setiap tahunnya.
segments.tr: Energy observers have previously frequently highlighted the need to improve the governance of subsidized fuel distribution so that it is more on target, considering the huge burden of the energy subsidy budget in the state expenditure structure every year.

segments.src: Uji coba sistem QR ini menjadi salah satu langkah konkret yang tengah diuji pemerintah untuk menjawab persoalan tersebut, meski hasil akhirnya masih perlu dipantau dalam beberapa waktu ke depan sebelum kebijakan ini benar-benar diterapkan secara menyeluruh.
segments.tr: This QR system trial is one of the concrete steps currently being tested by the government to answer this problem, although the final result still needs to be monitored in the next some time before this policy is truly applied thoroughly.

id-20260902-news-2.title: Danantara Cuts Number of SOEs from 1,074 to 254 Entities, State-Owned Insurance Merger Starts September 2026

segments.src: Badan Pengelola Investasi Daya Anagata Nusantara (Danantara Indonesia) dilaporkan mempercepat langkah konsolidasi terhadap ratusan badan usaha milik negara (BUMN) dan anak usahanya.
segments.tr: The Daya Anagata Nusantara Investment Management Agency (Danantara Indonesia) is reportedly accelerating consolidation efforts for hundreds of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and their subsidiaries.

segments.src: Dari total sekitar 1.074 entitas pelat merah yang berada dalam cakupan pemantauan, target akhir konsolidasi disebut hanya menyisakan sekitar 254 entitas yang dinilai solid secara finansial dan mampu menghasilkan keuntungan berkelanjutan.
segments.tr: Out of a total of approximately 1,074 state-owned entities under review, the final consolidation target is said to leave only about 254 entities that are considered financially solid and capable of generating sustainable profits.

segments.src: Berdasarkan informasi yang beredar, ribuan entitas tersebut dipetakan ke dalam empat kategori penanganan utama:
segments.tr: Based on circulating information, these thousands of entities are mapped into four main handling categories:

segments.src: - **Likuidasi** — untuk perusahaan yang dinilai sudah tidak memiliki prospek usaha yang jelas atau terus membebani keuangan negara.
segments.tr: - **Liquidation** — for companies deemed to have no clear business prospects or that continue to burden state finances.

segments.src: - **Divestasi** — pelepasan kepemilikan pada unit usaha yang dianggap tidak lagi sejalan dengan fokus bisnis inti BUMN induk.
segments.tr: - **Divestment** — the release of ownership in business units considered no longer aligned with the parent SOE's core business focus.

segments.src: - **Konsolidasi/merger** — penggabungan beberapa entitas dengan lini bisnis serupa agar lebih efisien dan kompetitif.
segments.tr: - **Consolidation/merger** — the merging of several entities with similar business lines to be more efficient and competitive.

segments.src: - **Restrukturisasi finansial** — penataan ulang struktur permodalan dan utang bagi perusahaan yang masih dianggap layak dipertahankan namun perlu penyehatan neraca.
segments.tr: - **Financial restructuring** — the reorganization of capital and debt structures for companies still considered worth maintaining but in need of balance sheet improvement.

segments.src: Langkah ini disebut sebagai bagian dari upaya jangka panjang untuk merampingkan portofolio BUMN, mengurangi tumpang tindih bisnis antar-entitas, sekaligus meningkatkan daya saing perusahaan negara di tengah tekanan ekonomi global.
segments.tr: This step is described as part of a long-term effort to streamline the SOE portfolio, reduce business overlap between entities, and simultaneously increase the competitiveness of state companies amidst global economic pressure.

segments.src: ## Merger Asuransi Pelat Merah Mulai Berjalan
Salah satu langkah konkret yang mulai terealisasi adalah proses penggabungan sejumlah perusahaan asuransi milik negara.
segments.tr: One concrete step that has begun to be realized is the merger process of several state-owned insurance companies.

segments.src: Proses merger di sektor asuransi pelat merah dikabarkan mulai berjalan pada September 2026, sejalan dengan agenda besar konsolidasi yang lebih luas.
segments.tr: The merger process in the state-owned insurance sector is reported to begin in September 2026, in line with the broader major consolidation agenda.

segments.src: Penggabungan ini diharapkan dapat memperkuat permodalan, memperluas basis nasabah, serta menyederhanakan struktur bisnis asuransi yang selama ini tersebar di beberapa entitas berbeda.
segments.tr: This merger is expected to strengthen capital, expand the customer base, and simplify the insurance business structure that has previously been spread across several different entities.

segments.src: Meski demikian, detail teknis mengenai entitas mana saja yang akan digabung, skema penggabungan, serta dampaknya terhadap nasabah dan karyawan masih perlu dikonfirmasi lebih lanjut melalui pengumuman resmi dari pihak terkait.
segments.tr: However, technical details regarding which entities will be merged, the merger scheme, and its impact on customers and employees still need to be confirmed further through official announcements from the relevant parties.

segments.src: ## Rebranding Rumah Sakit BUMN Jadi Indonesia Hospital
segments.tr: ## Rebranding of SOE Hospitals to Indonesia Hospital

segments.src: Selain sektor asuransi, konsolidasi juga menyentuh sektor layanan kesehatan.
segments.tr: In addition to the insurance sector, consolidation is also touching the healthcare service sector.

segments.src: Sejumlah rumah sakit milik BUMN dikabarkan telah menjalani proses rebranding menjadi satu identitas baru bernama Indonesia Hospital.
segments.tr: A number of SOE-owned hospitals are reported to have undergone a rebranding process into a new identity called Indonesia Hospital.

segments.src: Langkah ini dinilai sebagai upaya menyatukan standar layanan, memperkuat citra jaringan rumah sakit pelat merah, sekaligus mempermudah koordinasi operasional antar-rumah sakit yang sebelumnya berjalan dengan nama dan manajemen yang berbeda-beda.
segments.tr: This step is considered an effort to unify service standards, strengthen the image of the state-owned hospital network, and simultaneously facilitate operational coordination between hospitals that previously operated under different names and management.

segments.src: Rencana besar perampingan BUMN ini berpotensi membawa sejumlah implikasi, di antaranya:
segments.tr: This major SOE streamlining plan has the potential to bring a number of implications, including:

segments.src: 1. **Efisiensi anggaran negara** — berkurangnya jumlah entitas yang harus disubsidi atau disuntik modal oleh pemerintah.
segments.tr: 1. **State budget efficiency** — a reduction in the number of entities that must be subsidized or injected with capital by the government.

segments.src: 2. **Perubahan struktur ketenagakerjaan** — proses merger dan likuidasi berpotensi memengaruhi status karyawan di entitas yang terdampak.
segments.tr: 2. **Changes in employment structure** — the merger and liquidation process has the potential to affect the status of employees in the affected entities.

segments.src: 3. **Penguatan daya saing** — entitas hasil konsolidasi diharapkan lebih lincah bersaing dengan pemain swasta maupun asing.
segments.tr: 3. **Strengthening competitiveness** — the resulting consolidated entities are expected to be more agile in competing with private and foreign players.

segments.src: 4. **Kebutuhan transparansi** — publik dan pemangku kepentingan menantikan kejelasan kriteria serta jadwal pasti dari setiap tahap konsolidasi.
segments.tr: 4. **Need for transparency** — the public and stakeholders are awaiting clarity on the criteria and the exact schedule for each stage of consolidation.

segments.src: Sebagai proses yang masih berjalan, publik disarankan untuk terus memantau pengumuman resmi dari Danantara Indonesia dan kementerian terkait guna mendapatkan informasi terbaru dan akurat mengenai perkembangan konsolidasi BUMN ini, termasuk kepastian daftar entitas yang terdampak serta linimasa lengkap dari setiap tahapannya.
segments.tr: As this is an ongoing process, the public is advised to continue monitoring official announcements from Danantara Indonesia and the relevant ministries to obtain the latest and accurate information regarding the progress of this SOE consolidation, including confirmation of the list of affected entities and the complete timeline for each stage.

id-20260902-intro-agriculture-14.title: [Agronomy #14] Why Are Chili Prices at the Market 3 Times the Price at Farmers' Farms?

segments.src: > Bertani bukan cuma soal menanam — memahami biaya produksi, menghitung untung-rugi, dan mengenal jalur distribusi adalah keterampilan yang menentukan apakah usaha tani bertahan atau merugi.
segments.tr: > Farming is not just about planting — understanding production costs, calculating profit and loss, and knowing distribution channels are skills that determine whether a farm business survives or loses money.

segments.src: Kuliah ke-14 seri Pengantar Agronomi ini membahas sisi "bisnis" dari pertanian: **manajemen usaha tani dan pemasaran hasil pertanian**.
segments.tr: This 14th lecture in the Introduction to Agronomy series discusses the "business" side of agriculture: **farm management and agricultural marketing**.

segments.src: Tenang, Anda tidak perlu membaca 13 tulisan sebelumnya — kita mulai dari nol.
segments.tr: Relax, you don't need to read the 13 previous articles — we are starting from scratch.

segments.src: Ada tiga ide besar yang perlu dipahami.
segments.tr: There are three big ideas to understand.

segments.src: **Pertama, analisis biaya produksi.** Setiap usaha tani punya dua jenis biaya:
segments.tr: **First, production cost analysis.** Every farm business has two types of costs:

segments.src: - **Biaya tetap (fixed cost)**: biaya yang jumlahnya tidak berubah berapa pun hasil panen — misalnya sewa lahan, penyusutan traktor atau pompa air, dan pajak lahan.
segments.tr: - **Fixed cost**: costs whose amount does not change regardless of the harvest yield — for example, land rent, depreciation of tractors or water pumps, and land taxes.

segments.src: - **Biaya variabel (variable cost)**: biaya yang naik-turun mengikuti skala produksi — benih, pupuk, pestisida, dan upah tenaga kerja.
segments.tr: - **Variable cost**: costs that go up and down following the scale of production — seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and labor wages.

segments.src: Memisahkan keduanya penting karena strateginya berbeda.
segments.tr: Separating the two is important because the strategies are different.

segments.src: Biaya tetap ditekan dengan memakai aset seefisien mungkin (misalnya menyewakan traktor saat menganggur), sedangkan biaya variabel ditekan dengan penggunaan input yang tepat dosis dan tepat waktu.
segments.tr: Fixed costs are pressed by using assets as efficiently as possible (for example, renting out tractors when idle), while variable costs are pressed by using inputs with the right dosage and at the right time.

segments.src: **Kedua, evaluasi kelayakan usaha.** Ukuran paling sederhana yang dipakai di dunia agribisnis adalah **rasio R/C** (Revenue/Cost), yaitu total penerimaan dibagi total biaya:
segments.tr: **Second, business feasibility evaluation.** The simplest measure used in the agribusiness world is the **R/C ratio** (Revenue/Cost), which is total revenue divided by total costs:

segments.src: Jika R/C lebih besar dari 1, usaha tani menguntungkan; jika kurang dari 1, merugi.
segments.tr: If the R/C is greater than 1, the farm business is profitable; if it is less than 1, it is losing money.

segments.src: Selain itu ada konsep **titik impas (break-even point/BEP)** — jumlah produksi atau harga jual minimum agar penerimaan persis menutup seluruh biaya.
segments.tr: In addition, there is the concept of the **break-even point (BEP)** — the minimum production amount or selling price so that revenue exactly covers all costs.

segments.src: Di bawah titik itu, setiap kilogram yang dijual justru menambah kerugian.
segments.tr: Below that point, every kilogram sold actually adds to the loss.

segments.src: **Ketiga, struktur pemasaran (tata niaga).** Hasil panen jarang berpindah langsung dari petani ke konsumen.
segments.tr: **Third, marketing structure (trade system).** Harvest yields rarely move directly from farmers to consumers.

segments.src: Umumnya melewati rantai: petani → pedagang pengumpul (tengkulak) → pedagang besar di pasar induk → pengecer → konsumen.
segments.tr: Generally, it goes through the chain: farmer → collector trader (middleman) → wholesaler at the main market → retailer → consumer.

segments.src: Setiap mata rantai menambah biaya (angkut, sortir, kemasan, penyusutan) plus margin keuntungan — inilah **margin pemasaran**.
segments.tr: Every link in the chain adds costs (transport, sorting, packaging, shrinkage) plus a profit margin — this is the **marketing margin**.

segments.src: Semakin panjang rantainya, semakin besar selisih antara harga di tingkat petani dan harga yang dibayar konsumen.
segments.tr: The longer the chain, the greater the difference between the price at the farmer level and the price paid by the consumer.

segments.src: Persentase harga konsumen yang benar-benar diterima petani disebut **farmer's share**.
segments.tr: The percentage of the consumer price actually received by the farmer is called the **farmer's share**.

segments.src: Bayangkan Bu Sari, petani cabai rawit di Garut, Jawa Barat, menggarap lahan 1.000 m².
segments.tr: Imagine Bu Sari, a cayenne pepper farmer in Garut, West Java, cultivating a 1,000 m² plot of land.
**Her costs in one planting season (about 4 months):**

segments.src: - Biaya tetap: sewa lahan dan penyusutan alat ≈ Rp2.000.000
segments.tr: - Fixed costs: land rent and tool depreciation ≈ Rp2,000,000

segments.src: - Biaya variabel: bibit, pupuk, mulsa plastik, pestisida, upah tenaga kerja ≈ Rp6.000.000
segments.tr: - Variable costs: seeds, fertilizer, plastic mulch, pesticides, labor wages ≈ Rp6,000,000
The harvest is about 800 kg of chili.

segments.src: Tengkulak datang ke kebun dan membeli seharga Rp15.000/kg, jadi penerimaan Bu Sari **Rp12.000.000**.
segments.tr: The middleman comes to the farm and buys it for Rp15,000/kg, so Bu Sari's revenue is **Rp12,000,000**.

segments.src: Artinya setiap Rp1.000 yang dikeluarkan menghasilkan Rp1.500 — usaha ini layak, dengan keuntungan bersih Rp4.000.000 per musim.
segments.tr: This means every Rp1,000 spent produces Rp1,500 — this business is feasible, with a net profit of Rp4,000,000 per season.
But look at the other side.

segments.src: Cabai yang sama, setelah melewati pedagang pengumpul di Garut, pedagang besar di Pasar Induk Kramat Jati Jakarta, lalu pengecer di pasar dekat rumah Anda, dijual **Rp45.000/kg**.
segments.tr: The same chili, after passing through the collector trader in Garut, the wholesaler at Pasar Induk Kramat Jati Jakarta, and then the retailer at the market near your house, is sold for **Rp45,000/kg**.

segments.src: Farmer's share Bu Sari hanya `15.000 / 45.000 ≈ 33%` — dua pertiga harga yang Anda bayar terserap di rantai distribusi.
segments.tr: Bu Sari's farmer's share is only `15,000 / 45,000 ≈ 33%` — two-thirds of the price you pay is absorbed in the distribution chain.

segments.src: Mereka menanggung ongkos angkut Garut–Jakarta, risiko cabai busuk di jalan (cabai bisa susut 10–20%), dan fluktuasi harga harian.
segments.tr: They bear the Garut–Jakarta transport costs, the risk of chilis rotting on the road (chilis can shrink 10–20%), and daily price fluctuations.

segments.src: Namun rantai yang terlalu panjang memang menekan pendapatan petani.
segments.tr: However, a chain that is too long does squeeze farmer income.

segments.src: Karena itu banyak petani kini memotong rantai lewat koperasi, menjual langsung ke restoran atau supermarket dengan kontrak, atau memakai aplikasi penjualan hasil tani — semuanya upaya menaikkan farmer's share.
segments.tr: Therefore, many farmers now cut the chain through cooperatives, sell directly to restaurants or supermarkets with contracts, or use agricultural product sales apps — all efforts to increase the farmer's share.

segments.src: 1. Biaya usaha tani terbagi menjadi biaya tetap (tidak tergantung hasil panen) dan biaya variabel (mengikuti skala produksi), dan keduanya perlu dicatat terpisah.
segments.tr: 1. Farm business costs are divided into fixed costs (independent of harvest yield) and variable costs (following production scale), and both need to be recorded separately.

segments.src: 2. Kelayakan usaha dinilai dengan rasio R/C (untung jika di atas 1) dan titik impas (produksi/harga minimum agar tidak rugi).
segments.tr: 2. Business feasibility is assessed by the R/C ratio (profitable if above 1) and break-even point (minimum production/price to avoid loss).

segments.src: 3. Rantai distribusi yang panjang memperbesar margin pemasaran dan memperkecil farmer's share — memotong rantai adalah salah satu cara menaikkan pendapatan petani.
segments.tr: 3. A long distribution chain enlarges the marketing margin and shrinks the farmer's share — cutting the chain is one way to increase farmer income.

segments.src: Manakah yang termasuk biaya variabel dalam usaha tani?**
segments.tr: Which of the following is a variable cost in farming?**

segments.src: (O/X) Jika rasio R/C sebuah usaha tani bernilai 0,9 maka usaha tersebut menguntungkan.**
segments.tr: (T/F) If the R/C ratio of a farm business is 0.9, then the business is profitable.**

segments.src: Petani menjual mangga Rp10.000/kg, sedangkan konsumen di kota membelinya Rp25.000/kg.
segments.tr: A farmer sells mangoes for Rp10,000/kg, while consumers in the city buy them for Rp25,000/kg.

segments.src: - **Biaya tetap (fixed cost)**: biaya yang jumlahnya tidak berubah meskipun volume produksi berubah, seperti sewa lahan dan penyusutan alat.
segments.tr: - **Fixed cost**: costs whose amount does not change even if the production volume changes, such as land rent and tool depreciation.

segments.src: - **Biaya variabel (variable cost)**: biaya yang besarnya mengikuti skala produksi, seperti benih, pupuk, dan upah tenaga kerja.
segments.tr: - **Variable cost**: costs whose amount follows the scale of production, such as seeds, fertilizer, and labor wages.

segments.src: - **Rasio R/C**: perbandingan total penerimaan terhadap total biaya; nilai di atas 1 menandakan usaha menguntungkan.
segments.tr: - **R/C ratio**: the ratio of total revenue to total cost; a value above 1 indicates a profitable business.

segments.src: - **Margin pemasaran**: selisih antara harga yang dibayar konsumen dan harga yang diterima petani, mencakup biaya distribusi dan keuntungan pedagang.
segments.tr: - **Marketing margin**: the difference between the price paid by the consumer and the price received by the farmer, covering distribution costs and merchant profits.

segments.src: - **Farmer's share**: persentase harga konsumen akhir yang benar-benar diterima petani.
segments.tr: - **Farmer's share**: the percentage of the final consumer price actually received by the farmer.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1-c (pupuk dan upah panen naik-turun mengikuti skala produksi, sedangkan sewa, penyusutan, dan pajak adalah biaya tetap) · 2-X (R/C 0,9 berarti penerimaan hanya 90% dari biaya, jadi usaha merugi; untung jika R/C > 1) · 3-b (10.000 ÷ 25.000 = 0,4 atau 40% — sisanya menjadi margin pemasaran di rantai distribusi).*
segments.tr: *Answer: 1-c (fertilizer and harvest wages go up and down following production scale, while rent, depreciation, and taxes are fixed costs) · 2-F (an R/C of 0.9 means revenue is only 90% of cost, so the business loses money; profitable if R/C > 1) · 3-b (10,000 ÷ 25,000 = 0.4 or 40% — the rest becomes the marketing margin in the distribution chain).*
